overclaims: The study reports the contrast Marcus describes: strongly negative associations triggered by African American English alongside substantially more favorable overt associations.
checks.note: Excerpt and proposition are faithful. Axis, horizon and outcome match the reviews. Problem 1: e1 only says overt stereotypes are 'more positive', a relative term, so 'substantially more favorable' goes beyond the evidence. Problem 2: the limitation says the preprint 'was checked for the same finding', but no preprint excerpt is an evidence item. Only the drafter's explanation of e1 supports it. Minor: the cited excerpt drops 'By contrast,', but it is still a verbatim substring.
